N=27
fixed={9:23,12:13,18:1,21:21,26:14}
allcols=(1<<N)-1
sol=[None]*N
cols=0; d1=0; d2=0 # d1 index r-c+N-1, d2 r+c
for r,c in fixed.items():
    sol[r]=c
    cols |= 1<<c
    d1 |= 1<<(r-c+N-1)
    d2 |= 1<<(r+c)
rows=[r for r in range(N) if r not in fixed]

nodes=0
# static maybe center? We'll do MRV recalc.
def search(rows, cols, d1, d2):
    global nodes, sol
    nodes+=1
    if not rows:
        return True
    # select row min candidates
    best_i=None; best_mask=None; best_count=999
    for i,r in enumerate(rows):
        mask=allcols & ~cols
        # remove diag conflicts for row r: c forbidden if bit (r-c+N-1) in d1 or (r+c) d2
        # iterate columns maybe compute mask simpler loop
        m=0
        avail=mask
        while avail:
            bit=avail & -avail; c=bit.bit_length()-1
            if not ((d1>>(r-c+N-1))&1) and not ((d2>>(r+c))&1):
                m |= bit
            avail-=bit
        cnt=m.bit_count()
        if cnt<best_count:
            best_count=cnt; best_i=i; best_mask=m
            if cnt==0: break
    if best_count==0:
        return False
    r=rows[best_i]
    newrows=rows[:best_i]+rows[best_i+1:]
    # order maybe least constraining? Start with bits. Random? fixed no.
    # Try columns in order maybe
    m=best_mask
    # Use value ordering by counting future candidates descending
    candidates=[]
    while m:
        bit=m & -m; c=bit.bit_length()-1; m-=bit
        # quick score count remaining avail after placing
        ncols=cols|bit; nd1=d1|(1<<(r-c+N-1)); nd2=d2|(1<<(r+c))
        score=0; mincnt=100
        for rr in newrows:
            cnt=0
            avail=allcols & ~ncols
            aa=avail
            while aa:
                b=aa & -aa; cc=b.bit_length()-1; aa-=b
                if not ((nd1>>(rr-cc+N-1))&1) and not ((nd2>>(rr+cc))&1): cnt+=1
            score += cnt
            mincnt=min(mincnt,cnt)
            if cnt==0: break
        candidates.append((mincnt,score,c))
    # sort max mincnt/score
    candidates.sort(reverse=True)
    for _,__,c in candidates:
        bit=1<<c
        sol[r]=c
        if search(newrows, cols|bit, d1|(1<<(r-c+N-1)), d2|(1<<(r+c))):
            return True
        sol[r]=None
    return False

res=search(rows,cols,d1,d2)
print('res',res,'nodes',nodes)

# verify
if res:
    for r,c in enumerate(sol):
        assert 0<=c<N
    assert len(set(sol))==N
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(i+1,N):
            assert abs(i-j)!=abs(sol[i]-sol[j]), (i,j,sol[i],sol[j])
    for r,c in fixed.items(): assert sol[r]==c
    print('valid')
